json_ld.description:
NEW GIFT BUNDLE The perfect stocking stuffer or table setting, now in sets of ten. Give as thank-you gifts for friends, family, and everyone on your "good" list. Each tree-shaped box contains four Warming Joy pyramid tea infusers, one of each: Ginger Snap (black tea), Sweet Orange Spice (black tea), White Ginger Pear (white tea), and Winter Chai (herbal tea). All teas are Kosher Certified. Pairs perfectly with our Café Cups. Save when you buy as a bundle!
The Warming Joy Petite Tea Tree Set of 10 Gift Bundle is a $150 value and includes:

Ten Warming Joy Petite Tea Trees, 4 pyramid tea infusers in each

Each pyramid infuser steeps 8-12 ounces of tea
Each box measures 3.5L x 7.0D x 1.8H"

Please note: Pyramid infusers are not microwave-safe


All teas in this bundle are Kosher Certified
